notes: Personally read all 50 original gold-blinded reports in five groups of ten and reasoned every one of 600 targets under the frozen rubric. No other 016 annotations, gold values, legacy labels, external labels, regex/NLI labeling or default filling accessed/used. Python only assembled explicit personal decisions, expanded a fluid-conflict quote after source reread, and validated all original-language contiguous evidence, schema and complete UID coverage through rsna.labels.read_reviews. All unfinished work remained outside initiative. Explicit normal/absent findings and below-threshold findings distinguished in per-report notes; missing severity, extent, acuity, anatomy, side correspondence and contradictions remain masked where appropriate. Only coverage/completion/hash progress was sent to root during this reader task; target-specific decisions/flags withheld until independent source preread is frozen. Flags preserve contextual weak inferences for independent review. This reader draft does not confer training eligibility or image diagnostic accuracy.
